sn29.5:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn29.5:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacce saṃsedajā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantīti
sn29.5:1.5: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacce saṃsedajā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantīti.
